name: reasoning
description: Retrieve recent reasoning traces (chain-of-thought logs) recorded from prior reasoning-model calls (stored in state/reasoning.jsonl). Use this when you need to introspect or debug your own past reasoning — e.g. to spot repeated mistakes, review how you arrived at a decision, or extract insights from earlier thinking. Do NOT use this to process or summarize arbitrary text (use the rlm tool instead). Input: an optional integer field 'last' specifying how many recent traces to return (omit to get all).
